note.explanation: The section presents Quranic verses that encourage reflection on the origin and development of living things. It mentions water, human development, and differences in how animals move.
examples: The verse in Sura Al-Ambia says, “We made every living thing from water.”
The verse in Sura An-Nur describes animals that creep on their bellies, walk on two legs, or walk on four.
note.checkAnswer: The verse says that every living thing was made from water.
note.simple: The section asks us to think about what the Quran says about living things: their connection with water, how humans develop, and how animals move.

mcqs.stem: According to the verse quoted from Sura Al-Ambia, what was every living thing made from?
rationales: This is correct: the verse says, “We made every living thing from water.”
This is incorrect: clay like the potter is mentioned in the verse about man in Sura Al-Rehman.
This is incorrect: a little lump appears in the description of human development in Sura Al-Mominoon.
This is incorrect: flesh is mentioned as clothing the bones in the development sequence.

mcqs.stem: Which quoted verse describes the sequence from a drop to a clot, a little lump, bones, and flesh?
rationales: This is incorrect: Sura Al-Ambia, Verse 30, is quoted about living things being made from water.
This is incorrect: Sura Al-Rehman, Verse 14, is quoted about man being made from clay like the potter.
This is correct: Sura Al-Mominoon, Verse 14, gives this development sequence.
This is incorrect: Sura An-Nur, Verse 45, describes different ways animals move.

explain.title: Living things and water
explain.body: The section quotes the verse, “We made every living thing from water.” It says the Quran mentions in multiple verses that all living things were created from water. It also gives the average water content in different organisms as 60% to 90%.

explain.title: Man and clay
explain.body: The verse from Sura Al-Rehman says, “He made man from clay like the potter.” The section says that the hints in these verses advise us to think about possible ways the events in human creation occurred.

explain.title: Human development
explain.body: The verse from Sura Al-Mominoon describes a sequence: a drop becomes a clot, the clot becomes a little lump, bones are formed, and the bones are clothed with flesh.

explain.title: Animals and movement
explain.body: The verse from Sura An-Nur says that animals were created from water and describes some that creep on their bellies, some that walk on two legs, and some that walk on four legs.

mistakes: Mixing up the sura and verse references: Al-Ambia 30 is about living things and water; Al-Rehman 14 is about man and clay; Al-Mominoon 14 is about development; An-Nur 45 is about animals and movement.
Writing the human-development stages out of order or leaving out the bones or flesh stage.
Saying all animals move in the same way instead of giving all three forms described.
Adding claims that are not stated in the section when explaining what a verse says.
